content.value_statement: Complex data initiatives require coordinated legal, security, privacy, policy, standards, and sector review. This skill organizes those perspectives into evidence-based assessments and remediation plans.
actual_capabilities: Structures data lifecycle compliance reviews with phased workflows and role assignments.
Identifies data classification, important data, personal information, and sector-specific review needs.
Creates risk lists, remediation plans, assessment outlines, and evidence checklists.
Maps review topics to cited Chinese laws, regulations, and national standards.
Coordinates security, privacy, healthcare, policy, standardization, and market perspectives.
Applies explicit boundaries for legal opinions, certification decisions, and regulatory conclusions.
limitations: It does not replace advice or formal opinions from qualified legal counsel.
It cannot issue certifications, regulatory approvals, or official security assessment results.
Its policy references require verification against current official sources before use.
It depends on complete and accurate information about data, systems, purposes, and jurisdictions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a compliance readiness review
use_cases.description: Build a phased review covering data classification, privacy, security controls, industry rules, evidence gaps, and remediation priorities.

use_cases.title: Assess sensitive healthcare data
use_cases.description: Screen personal information, consent, anonymization, human genetic resources, data export, and healthcare-specific obligations before a proposed use.

use_cases.title: Plan security and standards work
use_cases.description: Map classification, protection-level, security maturity, privacy assessment, and applicable standards into an accountable implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic compliance review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data use case for major compliance and security concerns. List missing facts, applicable review areas, risks, and immediate next steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a project is still being defined.

prompt_templates.title: Create a data classification plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a classification and grading workshop for our datasets. Include participants, required evidence, important-data screening, decisions, and expected deliverables.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an organization needs a repeatable classification process.

prompt_templates.title: Assess personal information processing
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this personal information workflow. Cover legal basis, notices, consent, sensitive information, impact assessment, retention, rights, security, and remediation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before launching or changing a personal information workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate an advanced compliance program
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cross-functional compliance program for this data initiative. Assign expert roles, stage gates, evidence requirements, risk ratings, deliverables, dependencies, and verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for complex initiatives spanning legal, technical, sector, policy, and standards requirements.

output_examples.input: Assess whether customer transaction data can be used for a new analytics product.
output: Decision status: Conditional pending evidence review.
Priority checks: purpose compatibility, personal information basis, sensitive fields, retention, access controls, and important-data screening.
Next steps: complete the data inventory, document the legal basis, perform an impact assessment, and validate technical controls.

output_examples.input: Prepare a healthcare data compliance work plan for a research partnership.
output: Phase 1: classify medical, personal, sensitive, and genetic-resource data.
Phase 2: verify authorization, separate consent, ethics, export, and sector approval requirements.
Phase 3: define anonymization, access, audit, retention, incident response, and evidence owners.

output_examples.input: Turn our data security gaps into a remediation roadmap.
output_examples.output: The roadmap groups red and orange risks by legal urgency, control dependency, accountable owner, required evidence, target date, and verification method.

best_practices: Provide data categories, sources, purposes, recipients, locations, retention periods, systems, and jurisdictions.
Verify every cited requirement against current official sources and applicable sector rules.
Require evidence for each conclusion and assign accountable owners to every remediation action.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a general checklist as a final legal opinion or regulatory approval.
Do not assume de-identification makes data anonymous without testing re-identification risk.
Do not begin commercialization before resolving ownership, personal information, important-data, and sector-specific gate issues.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It structures analysis and identifies review needs, but qualified counsel must issue formal legal opinions.

faq.question: Which compliance areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers data classification, security, personal information, healthcare data, policy, standards, market context, and remediation planning.

faq.question: Can it determine whether data is important data?
faq.answer: It can organize screening and evidence, but final identification must follow current catalogs and competent authority requirements.

faq.question: Can it complete a personal information impact assessment?
faq.answer: It can draft the structure, questions, risks, and controls. The organization must supply evidence and approve the final assessment.

faq.question: Does it perform technical security testing?
faq.answer: No. It proposes controls and evidence checks but does not scan systems, test configurations, or conduct penetration testing.

faq.question: How current are its legal and standards references?
faq.answer: The knowledge base has a stated September 23, 2026 baseline. Users must verify references against current official publications.
